539-1491-3129-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

101-5478-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
101-5478-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Vampire Charmseeker and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Vampire Charmseeker and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.
101-5478-5531-5694-8110.notes:
If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Vampire Charmseeker and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.
An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

2511-5254-8122.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
You don't control an Army, or the only Army you do control is the creature with power 4 or greater.
2511-5254-8122.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature with power 4 or greater. If you control an Army, ensure to sacrifice that creature.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
2511-5254-8122.notes: The Orc Army will become a 5/5 due to the counters and the buff provided by The Muckslinger Gang.

339-677-1251-3899.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1308-4094-6753-6763-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1090-1594-1895-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

129-1409-3499-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1409-3099-6723-7296.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

5626-6462-7636.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less.
5626-6462-7636.notablePrerequisites: You have at least {E}{E}{E}{E} plus an additional {E} if the extra creature has mana value equal to 3.
5626-6462-7636.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Kheru Goldkeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kheru Goldkeeper enters, Twilight Diviner's second ability triggers, creating a token copy of Kheru Goldkeeper.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing Twilight Diviner and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning the creature sacrificed in step 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Both Kheru Goldkeepers trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the nontoken Kheru Goldkeeper and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Twilight Diviner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The token Kheru Goldkeeper and Twilight Diviner's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Twilight Diviner trigger, causing you to surveil 2.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Kheru Goldkeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The token Kheru Goldkeeper and Twilight Diviner's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Twilight Diviner trigger, creating a token copy of Kheru Goldkeeper.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing Twilight Diviner and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Each Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Twilight Diviner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Each Kheru Goldkeeper and Twilight Diviner's first ability trigger.
Resolve each Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Twilight Diviner trigger, causing you to surveil 2.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat from step 20.
5626-6462-7636.notes: To get infinite creature tokens, you must use a creature with mana value 2 or less. You then want to alternate sacrificing Kheru Goldkeeper, Twilight Diviner and that creature. Twilight Diviner's second ability will reset each time it's returned, allowing for additional creature tokens of either Kheru Goldkeeper or the other creature.

240-2511-5929.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Leyline of Transformation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-2511-5929.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

372-3647-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Displace exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3647-7487.description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Zealous Lorecaster and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Zealous Lorecaster trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Displace.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Zealous Lorecaster and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2769-3259-4478.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2769-3259-4478.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4478-4947-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

4188-7282-7340.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 5 life this turn.
4188-7282-7340.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

3259-4460-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
3259-4460-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

2034-3490-6458-6824.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2034-3490-6458-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-3594-5078-6595.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Lyse's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2034-3097-3490-6794.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

1575-2099-6748.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing another artifact, which is a Food due to Ragost.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Alara.
uses.n: Invasion of Alara // Awaken the Maelstrom

111-2743-6231.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
111-2743-6231.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
111-2743-6231.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Defeat Invasion of Alara, causing you to exile it and cast Awaken the Maelstrom without paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Awaken the Maelstrom at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Awaken the Maelstrom spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

325-1786-5436-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-1786-5436-6282.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat.

1339-2034-2122-6254.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability twice by paying {2} and discarding two cards, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

3017-5742-5743-6441.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2157-2598-2696.easyPrerequisites: You have not copied a spell using The Sixth Doctor's ability this turn.
2157-2598-2696.notablePrerequisites: You control a mana-producing land and/or artifact.
2157-2598-2696.description:
Cast Teferi by paying {2}{W}{U}.
The Sixth Doctor triggers, copying the Teferi spell, with the copy being nonlegendary.
Resolve both Teferi spells.
Activate a mana-producing land or artifact by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Teferi token.
Activate a Teferi token's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping Romana II, the mana-producing land or artifact and up to one other land or artifact, and causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 4.

643-2102-3814.notablePrerequisites:
Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional land.
643-2102-3814.description:
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping Griffin Canyon and another land.
Activate Griffin Canyon's second ability by tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder and giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

586-4365-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Priest of Gix that are 6/6 Dinosaurs.
When the Priest of Gix tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding six {B}.
Repeat.

108-4013-4365.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
When Eyeless Watcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1409-1671-2895-4826.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1409-1671-2895-4826.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters untapped due to Archelos, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-2429-3193.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Olivia deathtouch.
1308-2429-3193.description:
Give Olivia deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Olivia's first ability by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls, destroying it due to Olivia's deathtouch, and putting a +1/+1 counter on Olivia.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches' first ability triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you have a way to give Olivia deathtouch indefinitely, you may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

396-1309-1333-4050.notablePrerequisites: At least two of your opponents have a creature card in their graveyard.
396-1309-1333-4050.description:
Cast Ghouls' Night Out by paying {3}{B}{B}, returning Salvager of Secrets from your graveyard to the battlefield, and at least two other creatures from your opponents' graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Salvager of Secrets and the creatures enter the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers once for each creature, and Salvager of Secrets triggers once.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Ghouls' Night Out from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve all Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating that many 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing Salvager of Secrets, two creatures your opponents own, and two Unicorns, adding {3}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

141-2417.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Siren's Ruse.
141-2417.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Siren's Ruse, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Siren's Ruse, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.
